      "action": "The POP3 server removes all messages marked as deleted from the maildrop and replies as to the status of this operation. <json>
{
  "states": [
    "Waiting for connection",
    "Connected",
    "Authenticated",
    "Transaction",
    "Update",
    "Closing"
  ],
  "transitions": [
    {
      "from": "Waiting for connection",
      "event": "<open connection>",
      "action": "+OK POP3 server ready",
      "to": "Connected"
    },
    {
      "from": "Connected",
      "event": "APOP",
      "action": "+OK mrose's maildrop has 2 messages (320 octets)",
      "to": "Authenticated"
    },
    {
      "from": "Authenticated",
      "event": "STAT",
      "action": "+OK 2 320",
      "to": "Transaction"
    },
    {
      "from": "Authenticated",
      "event": "LIST",
      "action": "+OK 2 messages (320 octets)",
      "to": "Transaction"
    },
    {
      "from": "Transaction",
      "event": "RETR 1",
      "action": "+OK 120 octets",
      "to": "Update"
    },
    {
      "from": "Update",
      "event": "DELE 1",
      "action": "+OK message 1 deleted",
      "to": "Transaction"
    },
    {
      "from": "Transaction",
      "event": "RETR 2",
      "action": "+OK 200 octets",
      "to": "Update"
    },
    {
      "from": "Update",
      "event": "DELE 2",
      "action": "+OK message 2 deleted",
      "to": "Closing"
    },
    {
      "from": "Closing",
      "event": "QUIT",
      "action": "+OK dewey POP3 server signing off (maildrop empty)",
      "to": "Waiting for connection"
    }
  ]
}
</json>
